title: Infinite Jump EXPLOIT 1.0 Dragonwilds
author: FastTipsGaming
description: In this video, I'll be showing you how to perform the infinite jump exploit/glitch in Runescape Dragonwilds.

transcript.text: Welcome to Fast Tips Gaming. Today, I'll be showing you how to do the infinite double jump exploit in RuneScape Dragon
Wilds. The only thing you need is access to a melee weapon, two spells, and enough runes to cast them.
The first spell is wind step. That's a no-brainer. The second spell is pretty much any AoE spell. Everyone pretty much
agrees that magical mending is the best one to use because most people unlock it earlier than the others.
Now, here's the thing. I'm on a console, but exactly how I set this up and exactly what buttons to push to pull
this off. I'm warning you right now. This is going to take at least an entire hour of practice before you'll be able to
effectively use it. Also, rest assured that you will run into the game's most dangerous enemy of all, the mother
stupid ass auto save. If the game auto saves while you're trying to perform this trick, you're going down.
Moving on to the actual trick, clear some room in one of your spell radials and place only two spells, wind step and
magic mending. You'll notice I have them both on the quick spell dial. That's not by
accident. You are free to do this trick however you like, but I'm going to show you how I do it and the exact buttons I
press. So, if you decide to put these spells on different dials, then you'll need to adjust them yourself.
With all that being said, give yourself plenty of room and press triangle then L1. This simply gives you wind step.
Then press X to jump, which activates your wind step. Easy enough so far, right? Then, at the height of your jump,
press R1 to do a slam attack. I would practice this step a few times before proceeding to make sure your
fingers learn it well. Now, we're going to change it up and press triangle in the very beginning of
our slam attack, which will bring up the spell menu again. Press L2 to activate the spell magical
mending, which also cancels out your slam attack. Again, practice this step a few times
and make sure you can actively spell cancel before proceeding with the next step.
Once you've practiced a few times, we're going to add a few things to it. After activating magical mending, press
L2 again to cancel the spell. After you cancel the spell, simply press X again to jump. Again,
take your time. This is a crucial skill that you will need in order to access parts of the game that Jagex doesn't
want you to have access to. Take your time and practice. Once you can perform all of these actions
properly, you're ready for the next step. After jumping, you're going to press R1 to do another slam attack. Again,
during the slam attack, press triangle to bring up the spell menu. Press L2 to select magical mending, then press L2
again to cancel it. Lastly, press X to jump again. This is the sequence you need to practice over
and over until you don't even need to think about it and your fingers start to move on their own.
This took me about 2 hours before I was ready to use it in the actual world of Dragon Wilds. So, don't be frustrated if
you can't do it after a few minutes. This is a difficult skill that will take time to learn.
Once you learn, it's like riding a bike. You'll never forget. I hope this helped
teach you something you'll use. Have fun exploring forbidden places, and as always, thank you so much for watching,
guys. Until next time.
